sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: A stem that ends in *s*, *sz* or *z* does not take *-sz*; *olvas* + *sz* would pile up the same sounds. It takes *-ol*, *-el* or *-öl* instead. The vowels choose, as they do for *-ok/-ek/-ök*: back vowels *-ol*, front vowels *-el*, *ö* or *ő* *-öl*.

sections.title: Stems ending in s or z

sections.content: Look at the last letter of the stem. *Tanul* ends in *l*, so *tanulsz*. *Olvas* ends in *s*, so *olvasol*. The “I” form does not change: *olvasok*, *főzök*, *kérdezek*.
